One day, in a dark alley, he loses control and pins her against the wall, forcing her to take off her mask. But Misaki doesn't pull away — she steals a kiss herself. Thus begins their secret romance. Sex with Misaki is sweet and intoxicating — completely unlike what he experiences with his girlfriend — and gradually it consumes Saeki completely.(Source: Ryona-sensei)
